metadata.feature_name: Disorders of menstruation and other abnormal bleeding from female genital tract
metadata.selection_basis: FDR-significant at M4 in at least one source OSA contrast
metadata.event_definition: Incident feature PheCode in the harmonized-washout at-risk set
metadata.cpap_time_origin: Landmark at OSA study index plus selected grace period
metadata.cpap_interpretation: The grace-period landmark addresses immortal-time bias. Curves are still descriptive and unadjusted; healthy-adherer confounding remains.
metadata.release_note: Aggregate cumulative-incidence percentages are approved for public research dissemination; exact timepoint count arrays remain withheld.

strata.cpap_window_definition: The clock starts at index plus the selected grace period among OSA patients who remain under observation and event-free to that landmark.
strata.cpap_exposure_definition: Source-defined nightly-use categories among OSA patients after a 90- or 180-day landmark. Unknown means a device was set up but usage was not captured.
